title: de-dwd : DWD Service Maintenance / Update
description:
Dear colleagues,

We would like to inform you of scheduled maintenance for the DWD WIS2 services including Global Services hosten by us.

*Maintenance window:*
05.05.2026, from 07:00 to 08:00 (UTC)

*What to expect:*
 * WIS2 nodes Cyprus (cy-dom) and USA (us-cimss) will experience a brief outage during the broker restarts.
 * For all other services (WIS2 nodes Germany (de-dwd) and Israel (il-ims), GC (de-dwd-global-cache), GDC (de-dwd-global-discovery-catalogue), GTS-to-WIS2 Gateway (de-dwd-gts-to-wis2)), the broker will remain available, but no notifications will be emitted during this time.
 * Notifications/data for nodes Germany (de-dwd) and Israel (il-ims), as well as the gateway (GTS-to-WIS2 Gateway (de-dwd-gts-to-wis2)), will be published once maintenance is complete, so no data is lost. The GDC (de-dwd-global-discovery-catalogue) will also be unavailable for the duration of the maintenance window.
 * Global Cache (de-dwd-global-cache) is updated to a new version

*Reason for maintenance:*
 * Stability improvement
 * Internal network maintanance

*Impact:*
 * Delayed data notification
 * GDC not available
 * No data caching during maintanace GC

*Action required:*



*Contact point:*

Elena Arenskötter (wis@dwd.de)
